# anecdotes_frameworks (Data Source)

Lists all frameworks in the Anecdotes account, with optional filtering by adoption status or name.

Use this data source to discover frameworks and their IDs. For full framework details
(auditor configuration, control references, etc.), use the singular `anecdotes_framework` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all frameworks
data "anecdotes_frameworks" "all" {}

output "framework_count" {
  value = data.anecdotes_frameworks.all.total_count
}

output "frameworks" {
  value = data.anecdotes_frameworks.all.frameworks
}

# List only adopted frameworks
data "anecdotes_frameworks" "adopted" {
  is_applicable = true
}

output "adopted_frameworks" {
  value = data.anecdotes_frameworks.adopted.frameworks
}

# Search by name
data "anecdotes_frameworks" "nist" {
  name_contains = "NIST"
}

output "nist_frameworks" {
  value = data.anecdotes_frameworks.nist.frameworks
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `is_applicable` (Boolean) Filter by adoption status. Defaults to `true` — only adopted (active) frameworks are returned. Set to `false` to include unadopted system frameworks.
- `name_contains` (String) Filter frameworks whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `frameworks` (Attributes List) List of frameworks matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--frameworks))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of frameworks matching the filters.

<a id="nestedatt--frameworks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `frameworks`

Read-Only:

- `categories_count` (Number) Number of control categories in this framework.
- `description` (String) A detailed description of the framework.
- `framework_auditable` (Boolean) Whether auditors can access this framework.
- `framework_controls_categories` (List of String) List of control category IDs within this framework.
- `framework_id` (String) The unique identifier of the framework.
- `framework_status` (String) The catalog status of the framework (e.g., AVAILABLE, ARCHIVED).
- `is_applicable` (Boolean) Whether this framework is adopted for the organization.
- `name` (String) The human-readable name of the framework.
- `references_count` (Number) Number of control references in this framework.
